profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer and Technical Lead at FIS

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Leadership, Collaboration & Process
• Leads a team of Software Engineers developing and supporting retirement software, mentoring junior developers through code reviews, pull request feedback, and day-to-day guidance while fostering a culture of continuous growth
• Facilitates Agile/Scrum ceremonies as a SAFe Agile Certified practitioner, driving backlog refinement and sprint planning in close partnership with product owners and QA to ensure clear requirements and smooth delivery
• Collaborates cross-functionally with front-end, back-end, architecture, product owners, and QA teams, and partners closely with product vendors to influence and improve vendor tools to better meet organizational needs
• Authored comprehensive internal wikis that significantly reduced time to production and preserved critical institutional knowledge

Technical Development & Architecture
• Engineers cross-platform applications for web, responsive, and native mobile (Android & iOS) using a generative AI low-code platform (Wavemaker) with a strong emphasis on JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React Native, and REST APIs
• Actively participates in architecture and design discussions across multiple projects, providing technical guidance and review to ensure scalable, maintainable solutions
positions.insights: Leading Development Teams, Android Development and +5 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Modernized web retirement application using Angular. Setup RESTful APIs using NGRX framework.

• Modernized mobile banking application using the Ionic Framework and Angular for both iOS and Angular platforms. Wrote dozens of test cases to bring the check deposit feature my team and I built to a 90% coverage rating in SonarQube. Setup frontend API services to connect with backend servers. Refactored feature code to create a uniform and well-documented code base. 

• Worked with a small team to build an internal LinkedIn-type application from scratch using mainly Angular, with a focus on gamification. Personally created the notification system for this application (both front and back ends, using MariaDB as the database). Created the Swagger documentation for this project.

positions.title: Site Administrator - Major Accounts
positions.description:
Client Relations & Customer Service
• Served as primary liaison between two multi-million dollar organizations, building and maintaining strong relationships with customer stakeholders as the first point of contact for all service, supply, equipment, and project needs
• Consistently delivered top-tier customer service internally and externally, balancing competing priorities with professionalism and urgency while leveraging deep knowledge of the customer's internal processes to connect them with the right resources
• Demonstrated strong critical thinking and creative problem-solving skills, regularly developing on-the-spot solutions to meet customer needs within operational constraints

Process & Relationship Management
• Played a critical role in maintaining the health and longevity of an ongoing multi-million dollar contract through proactive relationship management, consistent service excellence, and timely fulfillment of requests across services, supplies, new equipment, and special projects
• Designed and implemented new workflows while seamlessly integrating existing processes, improving operational efficiency and day-to-day operations
• Successfully managed a heavy self-directed workload with minimal oversight, demonstrating strong time management, organizational skills, and accountability
positions.insights: Project Management, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and +4 skills

positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description: In this role, I provided excellent customer service to our customers through managing a reception area, greeting visitors, providing dispatch and supply services, handling new contracts, and contacting customers for needed information. I worked with other departments as needed to ensure customers received fast and efficient service.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I graded papers and exams, and assisted the professor with any duties he needs including being available to students and helping them learn the material.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: I participated as a research assistant in a psychology research lab at Florida State University. I conducted lab experiments with research participants, supervised new research assistants, as well as data entry and research for experiments.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Alpha Phi Omega National Service Fraternity
volunteerExperiences.description: I am a Brother of Alpha Phi Omega and did volunteering all over the state of Florida at many different places and for many different events.

company.name: Alpha Phi Omega National Service Fraternity

volunteerExperiences.description: I am a member of the Central Florida Community Arts Symphony Orchestra. We perform throughout the year for the community in the form of concerts and other community events.

projects.title: Super Mario Bros. Clone
projects.description: I worked with a team to create a Super Mario Bros. clone using Unity, git, and networked with Azure and Photon Unity Networking.

projects.title: NASA API How-To-Guide
projects.description: I completed this website for my Web Development course. It is a introductory How-To Guide for using the NASA API using Ajax calls. This was to supplement the existing documentation for the API.
